deferred_to_upstream.feature: Promoted list endpoints that also declare pagination should keep response_path, so `postings` returns jobs at a predictable top level instead of nested under results.jobs.
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Because response_path is dropped, `postings --json` emits {meta, results:{jobs:[...]}} while every sibling command in this CLI returns its rows at the top level. Callers reasonably reach for .jobs[0], get null for every field, and have to discover .results.jobs[0] by inspection. The same gap is why this CLI's local-store layer had to be hand-written against store.UpsertBatch rather than generated. A generator fix supersedes both.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Promoted endpoint rows should expose an extractable ID field so paginated reads can be cached locally.
deferred_to_upstream.reason: `postings` warns 'items returned but not cached locally (no extractable ID field)' even though every job row carries id_icims. Offline lookup against those rows stays incomplete until the generated read path can identify the key. Tracked with the same response_path defect.
